brief_title: A 2 Year Trial of Patients With Type 2 Diabetes Focusing on Cardiovascular Diagnostics and Metabolic Control

eligibility.criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Type 2 diabetes
* Ages 18-75 years
* Men and women
* At least one cardiovascular risk factor (i.e hypertension, dyslipidemia, smoking/formerly smoker, premature familial coronary artery disease \[CAD\], microalbuminuria)
* Written informed consent given

Exclusion Criteria:

* Unwillingness
* Age \< 18 or \> 75 years
* Unstable cardiovascular condition
* Unstable medical condition
